title: Inex One Updates M&A in the Expert Network Industry Analysis for 2026
summary: Inex One updated its M&A tracker for the expert network industry in February 2026, covering continued PE interest from Silver Lake, Permira, Astorg, and SFW Capital, plus recent transactions including Uzabase's acquisition of Sealed Network and Techspert's debt raise.
whyItMatters: Inex One's M&A tracking provides real-time intelligence on consolidation trends reshaping the expert network industry.
